stance_rationale: PD20C Path3 is not admission-grade because its own primary metrics show turnover hard fail at 613% round-trip annual, MDD regression versus S4, and DM/Harvey strict failure. Pure-function hashes, alpha time-series depth, covariance PSD, and chart visibility pass, but RF-F2/RF-F4/RF-F5/RF-F6 plus unresolved PIT inheritance prevent approval.

critical_concerns.description: Path3 fails its own deployment gate: portfolio-weighted round-trip turnover is 613.0% versus the hard 600% limit, MDD is worse than S4 by +0.85pp, and DM t_NW is only 1.154. A self-disclosed failure report is useful, but it cannot be approved as a Forge-valid package.

The requested canonical qepm/mailbox/worktask/WT-D20260511_001/weights.csv is absent. The fallback stage_artifacts weights.csv has only 155 dates ending 2023-11 and reflects a stale high_20pct sleeve schedule, while Path3 claims 184 dates via composite holdings. composite_top20_holdings_pd20c_path3.csv is time-series evidence, but it is not the mandated weights.csv schedule.

Baseline fairness is incomplete. S4 is recomputed over the same 256m period, but the script compares cost-embedded Path3 returns against a cost-free S4 baseline and applies no shared DSR penalty. Same-period alone does not satisfy same-period, same-cost, same-DSR comparison.

Forge-level Harvey/DSR evidence is missing for the Path3 composite net return stream. Risk-package 5-spec results validate the alpha/top20 source, not this 4-sleeve Path3 portfolio after buffer, cash redistribution, cost embedding, and 2005-2026 splice.

PIT inheritance is over-claimed. Alpha challenge context still accepts PIT-C13/C14 on timeline, while Path3 source comments and package text inherit expanding direction alignment as compliant. A known Z_Score_Aligned/Usable_Date gap cannot be converted into Forge PIT PASS by inheritance.

Lockbox visualization passes because the strategy line is visible after the 2023-12-22 marker, but frozen-extension evidence is absent. Path3 appears to use refreshed 2024-2026 alpha dates rather than a sealed/frozen extension and does not provide clean Pre-LB, Lockbox, and Combined reporting.

Source/package/artifact lineage is stale. The package says charts are TBD although chart files exist later; backtest_contract is only 5/10; and the current build script still contains an MDD_pass direction that would mark larger max drawdown as better, while the RDS/package artifact shows the corrected false result.

The max_names claim depends on an ETF/cash exemption and sleeve aggregation. Base constraints state max_names=20 hard; Path3 has 20 equities plus 9 ETF/cash sleeve instruments. If AX-007 multi-sleeve exception is used, the exemption must be formalized for this Forge package rather than asserted as N_stocks_max_20.

supporting_arguments: Pure-function audit passes: alpha/risk/optimization md5 start and end all match, and current file md5 values match package claims.
stage_artifacts/WT_D20260511_001/alpha_scores.parquet is a real time-series panel: 62,916 rows, 184 sig_dates from 2011-01-01 to 2026-04-01, 770 tickers.
stage_artifacts/WT_D20260511_001/covariance.parquet is PSD and condition-clean in the inspected 100x100 matrix: min eigenvalue 0.01217, condition number 8.81 <= 100.
equity_curve.png, annual_returns.png, and oos_zoom_chart.png are present; the equity and OOS charts visibly continue after the lockbox marker.
Turnover arithmetic uses the round-trip x2 structure correctly; the blocker is the resulting 613% hard fail, not the formula.
unresolved_disputes: Whether composite_top20_holdings_pd20c_path3.csv can substitute for the mandated canonical weights.csv.
Whether a cost-free S4 baseline is acceptable when the role prompt requires same-cost comparison.
Whether risk-package 5-spec alpha validation can substitute for Path3 composite portfolio 5-spec validation.
Whether post-lockbox monthly alpha refresh should be treated as admissible validation or only as combined/monitoring evidence.
Whether ETF and cash sleeves are exempt from the base max_names=20 hard constraint without a formal AX-007 package-level waiver.
Whether PIT-C13/C14 timeline acceptance can be inherited as Forge PIT compliance.
weakest_assumption: The package assumes that 184-date composite holdings plus self-disclosed failure are enough to make Path3 a valid Forge artifact, even though the canonical weights.csv, same-cost baseline, DSR penalty, Path3 5-spec regression, frozen lockbox extension, and PIT-C13/C14 closure are still missing or inconsistent.
rebuttal_required: Produce a canonical PD20C Path3 weights.csv with full as_of_date-level ticker or sleeve weights and reconcile it to the 184 composite holdings dates.
Recompute S4 baseline under the same 15bps cost model and apply the same candidates_tried DSR penalty to strategy and baseline.
Run CAPM, Carhart-3, Carhart-4, FF5, and FF6 regressions on Path3 net returns, with t_NW, alpha_monthly, and DSR reported.
Resolve alpha PIT-C13/C14 by rebuilding with Factor DB Z_Score_Aligned only and Usable_Date audit, then report Path3 delta.
Provide frozen lockbox extension plus Pre-LB, Lockbox, and Combined metrics.
Reduce round-trip turnover below 600% and rerun the full Forge package from source after syncing charts and backtest_contract artifacts.
rationalization_red_flags: TC drag annual 4-17bps across candidates (negligible vs SR delta)

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Other agents may validate prior PD18 or med_10pct variants, but this PD20C Path3 draft itself fails turnover and lacks canonical schedule, same-cost baseline, DSR, and Path3 5-spec evidence. Codex should not be counted as a PASS source for this package.

Lockbox period strategy NAV가 equity_curve에 visible한가? YES, but frozen-extension evidence is absent.
